author: David Scheer
description: A purported suicide note from Jeffrey Epstein, which his former cellmate said he discovered tucked in a book, was released by a federal judge on Wednesday.
title: Jeffrey Epstein’s Purported Suicide Note Released by US Court

author: Emily Birnbaum
description: A government ethics group has accused a pair of super political action committees backed by artificial intelligence investors of improperly concealing which companies they are paying to create advertisements and send messages to voters.
title: AI Super PACs Are Improperly Hiding Payments, FEC Complaint Says

author: Ainsley Thomson
description: New Zealand is weighing the purchase of advanced warships from Japan or the UK to modernize its aging fleet and bolster its defense capability.
title: New Zealand Eyes Japan, UK Warships as Frigate Replacements

author: Sherif Tarek
description: The Israeli army carried out an attack in the southern suburbs of Beirut on Wednesday, the first in the vicinity of the Lebanese capital since a US-brokered ceasefire came into effect last month.
title: Israeli Army Carries Out First Strike on Beirut Since Ceasefire

author: Chris Strohm
description: The Trump administration can keep 2020 election ballots and other materials it seized in January from a Georgia county in connection with President Donald Trump’s unsubstantiated claims that voting was mired by fraud that led to his defeat, a federal judge ruled.
title: Judge Says DOJ Can Keep Georgia Ballots Seized in Vote Probe

author: Michael J Kavanagh
description: Democratic Republic of Congo President Felix Tshisekedi said he’s willing to run for a third term — which is currently unconstitutional — if the Congolese people ask him to through a referendum.
title: Congo President Says He’d Run for Extra Term If Voters Want

description: Marc Short, former Chief of Staff to Vice President Mike Pence and now Chairman of Advancing American Freedom, says heavy Republican spending against fellow GOP candidates could "demoralize" voters and backfire in November, as members grow increasingly fearful of crossing President Trump. He also warns rising gas prices and higher costs for farmers—including fertilizer and trade pressures tied to tariffs—could weigh on voters in Middle America and threaten Republican strength in traditionally safe districts. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Marc Short Warns GOP Infighting Could Hurt in November

description: Former Treasury Secretary under President Barack Obama and former US Ambassador to Israel under President Joe Biden, Jack Lew, says pushing Iran to "zero enrichment" would be a step beyond the 2015 nuclear deal, while emphasizing the need for strict monitoring and removal of enriched uranium. He warns the economic fallout from the conflict depends on how long the Strait of Hormuz remains closed, with prolonged disruption likely to fuel energy shocks and consumer stress. Lew also says recent market strength reflects underlying US economic resilience but cautions risks could build if the conflict drags on. He speaks with Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran 'Zero Enrichment' Would Be Step Forward: Lew

author: Ari Natter
description: The Trump administration is studying using oil under land at US military bases and other Department of War sites to help refill the nation’s depleted emergency reserves, according to a person familiar with the matter.
title: US Considers Tapping Oil Under Military Bases to Refill Reserve

author: Kate O'Keeffe
description: A mishandled blacklisting of tech giants Alibaba and Baidu gives a rare window into an administration often at odds with itself on how to approach Beijing
title: Pentagon’s Botched Blacklist Highlights Frail Trump-Xi Truce

description: "They want to make a deal badly," President Donald Trump says when asked about the latest developments in the Iran conflict during remarks with reporters at the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says 'We Won' When Asked About Latest on Iran

author: Nancy Cook
description: The Indiana primary results were a victory, but came at a cost.
title: Trump Shows He Still Has Clout With GOP as Wider Popularity Declines

description: On the early edition of Balance of Power,  Bloomberg's Joe Mathieu and Carol Massar discuss the geoeconomics impact of the US war with Iran, as both countries weigh a deal to end the conflict. Joe and Carol also discuss the current sports investment landscape as they talk to celebrated athletes and top league officials. On today's show, Principal Asset Management chief global strategist Seema Shah, leader for Hogan Lovells’ Government Relations and Public Affairs Practice. Aaron Cutler, Driscoll's CEO Soren Bjorn, Olympic Gold Medalist Breezy Johnson and chief revenue and philanthropic officer for US Ski & Snowboard Breezy Johnson, administrator for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services Dr. Mehmet Oz, and NASCAR Hall of Famer and Vice Chairman of Henrick Motorsports Jeff Gordon and NASCAR chief operating officer Ben Kennedy. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Corporations Contend With Iran Economic Fallout | Balance of Power: Early Edition 5/06/2026

author: Jen Judson
description: The Pentagon awarded a $500 million contract to Meta Platforms Inc.-backed Scale AI to help sift through data and assist in decision-making, the latest step in the US military’s effort to rely more on artificial intelligence.
title: Meta-Backed Scale AI Wins $500 Million Defense Department Deal

author: Zoe Tillman, Laura Curtis
description: The Trump administration has begun paying out refunds for the $166 billion in global tariffs that the US Supreme Court declared unlawful earlier this year.
title: Tariff Refunds Have Started Being Paid by Trump Administration

description:
NASCAR Hall of Famer Jeff Gordon and chief operating officer Ben Kennedy discussed growth initiatives aimed at expanding media rights deals and getting an iconic American sport in front of younger viewers. 
Asked about the rise in Formula 1 fans in the United States, Gordon said that despite the differences between the two organizations, he believes motorsports is growing 'everybody's growing along with it.'  Gordon and Kennedy also discussed the important of well-known manufacturers to the success of NASCAR in the domestic market.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Rise of F1 in US Means All of Motorsports is Growing Says NASCAR Hall of Farmer Jeff Gordon

description:
Dr. Mehmet Oz, administrator for the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, said that Trump policies aimed at the Affordable Care Act will double the life expectancy of the Medicare trust fund by weeding out fraud in the system. 
Oz said that lack of system oversight on fraudulent medical practices, including hospice care in Los Angeles, encourages corruption in the health care industry. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Policies Will Double Life Expectancy of Medicare Trust Fund, Says Dr. Oz

description: Dr. Mehmet Oz, administrator of the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, talks about how the White House is making prescription drugs more affordable, fighting fraud in healthcare, and the future of Medicare. He speaks to Bloomberg Television at the Milken Global Conference.  (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Dr. Oz on Fighting Fraud, Lowering Drug Costs

author: Alberto Nardelli, Volodymyr Verbianyi, Jeff Mason
description: Ukraine’s chief negotiator, Rustem Umerov, is expected to travel to Miami to meet with US special envoy Steve Witkoff as early as this week, according to people familiar with the matter.
title: Ukraine Chief Negotiator Set to Travel to US to Meet Witkoff

author: Janet Lorin
description: The Justice Department said it uncovered evidence that the University of California at Los Angeles’ medical school intentionally and illegally selected applicants based on their race.
title: DOJ Says UCLA Medical School Selected Students Based on Race

description: President Donald Trump says the US is dealing with people in Iran that want to make a deal to end the war. He speaks at the White House. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Trump Says US Is Dealing With Right People in Iran

author: Volodymyr Verbianyi, Alberto Nardelli
description: Volodymyr Zelenskiy is asking Western allies to speed up deliveries of air-defense systems and interceptor missiles to prepare for another winter of intense bombing that could prove to be the next critical moment in Kyiv’s battle to resist the Russian invasion.
title: Ukraine Looks Beyond Summer Offensive to a Crucial Winter in the War

author: Courtney McBride
description: The US military disabled an Iran-flagged tanker that tried to dock at an Iranian port on the Gulf of Oman in violation of President Donald Trump’s blockade, the latest flareup around the Strait of Hormuz.
title: US Disables Iran-Flagged Ship That Tried to Break Blockade

author: Myles Miller, Josh Wingrove
description: The Federal Bureau of Investigation executed search warrants Wednesday at the Virginia office of L. Louise Lucas, one of the state’s most powerful Democrats, according to a person familiar with the investigation.
title: FBI Raids Office of Virginia Democrat Who Pushed Redistricting

author: Alex Morales, Lucy White
description: Doubts about Keir Starmer’s future as prime minister has fed months of plots and paranoia within the Labour Party about who, if anyone, might be ready to take his place. A bad set of results in the UK’s local elections would trigger more speculation.
title: The Labour Contenders Who Could Replace a Weakened Starmer

author: Peter Martin
description: A flurry of diplomatic activity in the last 24 hours suggests the US and Iran are making a fresh push to end their two-month war. Beyond the spotlight, leaders in Iran are making sure to tend to alliances with Russia and China along the way.
title: Iran Seeks an Edge as Diplomacy Builds Toward Possible War Deal

author: Salma El Wardany, Fiona MacDonald
description: Iran is evaluating a new proposal from the US to end their almost 10-week war, according to a person familiar with the matter, as China added its voice to global pressure to wrap up the conflict.
title: Iran Weighs Response to US Plan to End War as China Urges Peace

author: Zach Williams
description: A federal agency wants to learn how nuclear reactors could help the US expand its commercial presence on the high seas.
title: Trump Administration Explores Nuclear-Powered Commercial Ships

author: Suzanne Sataline
description: The administration is backing off one part of its sweeping immigration crackdown on overseas physicians, but applicants worry it may be too late to meet the critical residency and fellowship start date on July 1.
title: How Trump Has Made the Doctor Shortage Worse

author: Alex Morales, Fran Wang
description: Britons will head to the polls on Thursday for one of the most consequential rounds of local elections in memory, with control of the Scottish and Welsh parliaments and more than half of England’s councils at stake.
title: How Local UK Elections Could Decide Starmer’s Fate

author: Erik Larson
description: The US Justice Department will ask the Supreme Court to let it intervene in President Donald Trump’s appeal of the $83.3 million jury verdict against him in a defamation suit brought by former Elle magazine advice columnist E. Jean Carroll.
title: US Plans to Intervene in Trump’s Supreme Court Carroll Appeal

author: Carmen Arroyo
description: SOC Investment Group, an adviser to union-affiliated pension funds, is urging US regulators to probe SpaceX’s financials ahead of a Wall Street debut that could value the company at more than $2 trillion, citing concerns over its relationships with Elon Musk’s other ventures.
title: SpaceX Financials Flagged as Concern to SEC by Advocacy Group

author: Jamie Tarabay, Emily Birnbaum
description: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, a former neighbor of Jeffrey Epstein who visited the disgraced financier on his Caribbean island, on Wednesday becomes the first sitting cabinet member to testify to the US House committee investigating the sex offender’s crimes and possible lapses in the law enforcement response.
title: Lutnick to Testify on Epstein Ties Before US House Panel

author: Ania Nussbaum
description: A maritime coalition led by France and the UK is ready to escort tankers through the Strait of Hormuz if Iran agrees to a US proposal to end the war, according to a French official.
title: France Says Maritime Coalition Ready to Escort Tankers in Hormuz

author: Jenny Leonard, Max Ramsay, Hadriana Lowenkron
description: US President Donald Trump will discuss China’s continued energy purchases from Iran when he meets with President Xi Jinping next week, according to US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer.
title: Greer Says Trump and Xi Will Discuss China’s Iran Oil Purchases

author: Hadriana Lowenkron, Maggie Eastland
description: The White House is looking into an executive order that would create a vetting system for new artificial intelligence models like Anthropic PBC’s Mythos in a bid to protect business and government networks from AI-related cyber risks, a top economic adviser said Wednesday.
title: White House Prepares Order to Boost AI Security, Hassett Says

author: Annmarie Hordern, Lisa Abramowicz, Jonathan Ferro
description: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said changes the European Union is considering to a transatlantic trade deal could limit American exports to the bloc.
title: US Says EU’s Trade Deal Changes Could Weaken Agreement

author: Arne Delfs
description: The European Union needs to move with far more agility in a rapidly changing geopolitical environment to compete with the US and China, Germany’s top diplomat said as he laid out a series of reform proposals.
title: Germany Pushes EU to Speed Decisions to Compete With US, China

author: Bastian Benrath-Wright
description: A deal revamping Swiss relations with the European Union requires a constitutional amendment, according to a panel of lawmakers whose views hint at the hurdles the agreement will face.
title: Swiss-EU Deal Needs Change of Constitution, Bern Lawmakers Say

author: Magan Crane
description: President Donald Trump vowed to restart bombing Iran if Tehran does not agree to allow free passage through the Strait of Hormuz.
title: Trump Renews Pressure on Iran to Reopen Hormuz Strait

author: Jonathan Tamari
description: The secretary of State travels to Italy seeking to ease tensions with Europe and the pope
title: Rubio’s Europe Trip is Another Chance on World Stage

author: Suvashree Ghosh
description: Singapore will postpone considering an independent panel’s recommendations on the salaries of political office holders until the economic impact of the Iran war becomes clearer, a government minister said.
title: Singapore Defers Considering Political Pay Review on Iran War

author: Selcan Hacaoglu
description: Turkey is taking a significant step toward joining the global military elite by testing a missile that would put much of Europe and the Middle East within reach and eventually lead to the launch of real-time intelligence satellites, according to people familiar with the plans.
title: Turkey Joins Elite Military Powers With Planned ICBM Test

author: Brendan Scott, Irina Anghel
description: The Conservative-Labour duopoly that governed British politics for the past century appears locked in terminal decline. As a result, voters are no longer presented with a binary choice between opposing economic manifestos.
title: How the UK’s Fragmented Politics Are Reshaping Policy Agenda

author: Libby Cherry
description: Greece correctly calculated the price at which it bought back GDP-linked warrants last year, a London court ruled Wednesday, settling a long-standing dispute over the government’s debt repurchase.
title: Greece Wins UK Court Ruling Over Its Controversial Debt Buyback

author: James Attwood, Jacob Lorinc, Kai Schultz
description: The planned Project Vault stockpile aims to ensure supplies of rare earths and other strategic elements, but it could upend markets instead.
title: How Trump’s $12 Billion Stash of Critical Minerals Risks Distorting Markets

author: Mirette Magdy
description: Egypt’s inflation rate unexpectedly slowed in April, even after the Iran war spurred higher fuel costs and a weakening of the currency.
title: Egypt Inflation Unexpectedly Slows Despite Iran War Shocks

author: Antony Sguazzin
description: Johannesburg Mayor Dada Morero has been told by South African Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana that state funding to the city will be halted unless a 10.3 billion rand ($629 million) wage agreement is scrapped.
title: Johannesburg Told by Finance Minister It May Lose State Funds

author: Anthony Halpin
description: Russia resumed purchases of foreign currency and gold for its National Wellbeing Fund for the first time since June last year, as a surge in oil prices driven by the war in the Middle East boosts export revenue.
title: Russia Bolsters Rainy-Day Fund for First Time in Almost a Year

author: Laura Bliss, Bobby Magill
description: As the Trump administration prepares to move the US Forest Service to Utah, it’s been opening the door for unprecedented control by state and local governments—and use by industry.
title: A Fight Over Dirt in Utah Hints at the Future of America’s Public Lands

author: Daniel Carvalho
description: Tensions over Venezuela and the Iran war have prompted the Brazilian leader to speak out more openly against Trump.
title: Lula’s Election-Year Encounter With Trump Carries Risks

description: The US believes an agreement with Iran to end the near 10-week war is close, Axios reported, with Washington and Tehran working on a one-page memorandum of understanding that would set a framework for more detailed nuclear negotiations. Onur Ant reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Boosts Diplomatic Efforts to End Iran War as Trump Pauses ‘Project Freedom’

author: Brendan Scott, Fran Wang
description: The Green Party is seeking to reduce the UK’s borrowing costs by tackling the climate crisis and reducing inequality, its leader Zack Polanski said a day before England-wide local elections at which his party is predicted to make strong gains.
title: Greens’ Polanski Says Economic Plan Would Bring Down UK Debt

author: Jennifer A Dlouhy, Omar Tamo
description: The US believes it’s close to an agreement with Iran to end the near 10-week war, Axios reported, as China added its voice to global diplomatic pressure to wrap up the conflict.
title: US Boosts Efforts to End Iran War as Trump Suspends Hormuz Plan

author: Flavia Rotondi
description: The clash between Donald Trump and Pope Leo XIV has flared up again, complicating a delicate diplomatic mission by Secretary of State Marco Rubio to the Vatican this week.
title: Trump and Pope Are Sparring Again Ahead of Visit by Rubio

author: Weilun Soon
description: The suspension of a short-lived US plan to guide vessels through the Strait of Hormuz has underscored the difficulty of securing the waterway and left shipowners grappling for credible workarounds.
title: Shipowners Grapple for Fixes in Hormuz After Trump Drops Plan

author: Olesia Safronova
description: Ukraine said overnight drone and missile attacks showed the Kremlin had rejected Kyiv’s offer of a truce, raising the stakes ahead of Russian President Vladimir Putin’s demand for a ceasefire during the annual May 9 Victory Day parade in Moscow.
title: Ukraine Says Overnight Attacks Show Russia Rejected Truce Offer

description: US Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder says President Donald Trump could go ahead with a 25% tariff on European cars and trucks "relatively soon" if there is no progress on the bloc's ratification of a a trade deal that the two sides initially reached last July. Puzder talks with Bloomberg's Oliver Crook in Brussels. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Could Impose Auto Tariffs on EU 'Soon': Ambassador

author: Sam Dagher
description: As the Iran war grinds on, the US is ramping up pressure on allies in Iraq and Lebanon to neuter Tehran-linked proxies whose continued attacks threaten a tenuous ceasefire and remain a source of significant leverage for the Islamic Republic.
title: Iranian Proxies in Lebanon and Iraq Threaten Tenuous Ceasefire

author: Jorge Valero, Oliver Crook
description: US Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder said Washington will implement 25% tariffs on cars and trucks from the European Union “relatively soon” if the bloc doesn’t swiftly ratify a long-delayed trade deal.
title: US to Adopt 25% Car Levy ‘Soon’ Unless EU Clears Trade Deal

author: Fred Ojambo
description: Ugandan lawmakers passed controversial legislation with harsh penalties for entities and individuals receiving foreign funding without clearance from the East African government.
title: Uganda Lawmakers Pass Contentious Law Seen Targeting Opposition

author: Cliff Harvey Venzon, Claire Jiao
description: The Philippines on Wednesday called on Myanmar to give an Asean envoy access to Aung San Suu Kyi and provide greater transparency over her transfer to house arrest.
title: Philippines Seeks Asean Access to Myanmar’s Aung San Suu Kyi

author: Tooba Khan
description: The US State Department announced a phased shut down of its Consulate General in Pakistan’s Northwest Peshawar on safety concerns to its diplomats.
title: US to Close Mission in Pakistan’s Peshawar on Security Concerns

author: Paul Wallace
description: The president of the United Arab Emirates, Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed, and Israel’s Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu held a rare phone call this week, underscoring their countries’ deepening relations in the wake of the Iran war.
title: Netanyahu Holds Rare Call With UAE President as Defense Ties Deepen

author: Francesca Stevens, Cao Ban
description: Vietnam has ordered a clampdown on intellectual property violations, targeting a 20% increase in enforcement cases after the country was pegged as a top concern on a US watch list.
title: Vietnam Orders Crackdown on IP Violations After US Trade Warning

author: Firat Kozok, Beril Akman
description: Turkey’s leading opposition figures, including President Recep Tayyip Erdogan’s main rival, will stand trial on Wednesday in a criminal case seen as a harbinger for the party leadership.
title: Erdogan Rivals Stand Trial in Case That Risks Shaking Opposition

author: Nguyen Dieu Tu Uyen, Cao Ban
description: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi will hold talks with Vietnam President To Lam in New Delhi on Wednesday, with the two Asian nations looking to strengthen economic and defense ties while tensions persist in the Middle East.
title: Modi, Lam Meet as India and Vietnam Deepen AI, Defense Ties

author: Arne Delfs, Michael Nienaber
description: A year since taking office, Germany’s chancellor is struggling to fill the role he long dreamed of attaining
title: Merz’s Ambitions for Germany Crash Into a World Upended by Trump

author: Ainsley Thomson
description: New Zealand is looking at storing fuel in Malaysia and Singapore, a senior government minister said, as the impacts of the Iran war expose the risks from its limited domestic storage capacity.
title: New Zealand Eyes Fuel Storage Options in Singapore and Malaysia

author: Lucy White, Alex Morales
description: In the central London neighborhood of Hackney, Mayor Caroline Woodley is finding the Labour Party that’s dominated local government here for over 50 years to be an unusually hard sell.
title: Labour Risks Losing All Across London as City Flirts With Greens

author: Alastair Gale, Cliff Harvey Venzon
description: Japan’s decision to send combat troops to the Philippines for the first time since World War II and participate in a ship-sinking drill in the South China Sea this week underscores Tokyo’s rising willingness to project military power on China’s doorstep.
title: Japan Strikes Combat Role in South China Sea in Post-War Pivot

author: Ram Anand
description: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s coalition looks to have averted losing control of key Negeri Sembilan state after the United Malays National Organisation agreed to maintain its alliance despite its assembly members bolting from the state government.
title: Malaysia’s Anwar Averts Losing Key State as UMNO Alliance Holds

author: Nectar Gan
description: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met China’s top diplomat in Beijing, a visit that placed the close ties between the two strategic partners into focus just days before Donald Trump is scheduled to arrive in the Chinese capital.
title: Iran’s Top Diplomat Meets Wang Yi in First China Trip Since War

author: Thomas Seal
description: Police are investigating the unauthorized use of about 3 million citizens’ personal data in Alberta, the oil-rich Canadian province that appears headed toward a referendum on independence.
title: Alberta Independence Activists Embroiled in Voter Data Scandal

author: James Mayger
description: Australia and Fiji have agreed on a new security and political deal, as Canberra looks to shore up its influence in the region and limit China’s attempts to boost its presence across the Pacific.
title: Australia and Fiji Agree New Security Treaty With Eye on China

author: Anthony Capaccio, Alaric Nightingale
description: Top US officials spent Monday and Tuesday offering new details on the role the US military will play in helping ships pass through the Strait of Hormuz as part of President Donald Trump’s bid to break Iran’s chokehold over the waterway.
title: US Unveiled Plan to Reopen Hormuz Hours Before Trump Shelved It

description: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is traveling to Beijing for talks, marking the diplomat’s first visit to China since US and Israeli strikes sparked the most severe global oil supply shock in history. Bloomberg's Minmin Low reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran Foreign Minister Heads to China

description: "Balance of Power: Late Edition" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Representative Bryan Steil (R-WI) says while he hopes to see lower interest rates in the near future, the Fed must remain "data-driven, not politically-driven" in its decision making. Javier Garcia, CEO of World Central Kitchen, discusses the humanitarian impact of the conflict in the Middle East, saying he hopes to provide meals in Iran “if we can.” Senator Kirsten Gillibrand (D-NY) expresses optimism about the path forward for the CLARITY Act in Congress. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: US Says Iran Ceasefire Still In Place After Hormuz Clash | Balance of Power: Late Edition 05/05/2026
